caption:
Pressing the label flat

"It'll peel anyway." "Press it flat." The label said rice again, and it held.

A curling label is one press away from staying, and one more week away from falling off.

For whoever presses the curling label back down before it falls off.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a big clear container on the right with a paper label that says rice hanging off at a tilt. A brick-red block figure with narrowed eyes says it'll peel anyway. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers press it flat, and the label settles straight on the container with a small sparkle above it. The red one's eyes go wide and says ...still stuck. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me, pressing it flat.
